purpose: Bootstrap generates valid systemd unit files with proper service, socket, and security configurations.

input.rendered_bootstrap:
# Generate minecraft-vanilla.service
[Unit]
Description=Vanilla No Grief Minecraft Paper Server
After=network.target
Requires=minecraft-restore.service
After=minecraft-restore.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=minecraft
Group=minecraft
WorkingDirectory=/opt/minecraft/vanilla_no_grief
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/minecraft-start.sh
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=full
ProtectHome=true
ReadWritePaths=/opt/minecraft/vanilla_no_grief

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# Generate minecraft-restore.service
[Unit]
Description=Restore Vanilla No Grief Minecraft data from Wasabi
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/minecraft-restore.sh
StandardOutput=null
StandardError=null

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# Generate mcrcon.socket
[Unit]
Description=mcrcon RCON Socket
After=network.target

[Socket]
ListenStream=127.0.0.1:25577
NoDelay=true
KeepAlive=true

[Install]
WantedBy=sockets.target

# Generate mcrcon.service
[Unit]
Description=mcrcon RCON Server for Minecraft
After=network.target
Requires=minecraft-restore.service
After=minecraft-restore.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=minecraft
Group=minecraft
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/minecraft-mcrcon
EnvironmentFile=-/etc/default/mcrcon
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=full
ProtectHome=true
ReadWritePaths=/opt/minecraft/vanilla_no_grief

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
